name: SMTCraft
description: Shows what your system is playing right now - title, artist, album, cover art, synced lyrics with translation and a syllable-synced karaoke wipe - straight in your HUD. On Windows the metadata comes from the system media session (SMTC), on Linux from MPRIS2 over the D-Bus session bus, both through pure Java FFM with no helper process; lyrics come from Kugou (KRC), NetEase Cloud Music (YRC) and QQ Music (QRC).
